findings.finding: All identities renamed as explicit generic fictional learning venues; hours and addresses remain null. No current Beppu facility rules, prices, transport, bathing health benefit or admission conditions are asserted.
Onsen category retained; Sento Staff replaced with existing Onsen Staff. Public-bath context preserved with a locker-label problem distinct from the other bath scene.
Restaurant category retained; Chef changed to existing Restaurant Staff for order-record and bill handling.

Amusement Park category retained; Entertainment Staff changed to existing Amusement Park Staff. The fictional bowling reception belongs to a leisure facility, retaining bowling essence without adding a new asset/category.

Bath staff handles equipment and labels without health guarantees. Hotel staff confirms guests for a handoff without inventing actual arrival policies. Government and postal staff organize uncertain application scope for consultation without deciding eligibility or completion. Tourist options are tentative and require current conditions to be checked. Bowling equipment suitability is not guaranteed.
